proofBoundary.fixtureLevel: Real request/handler code with synthetic Auth/PostgREST/Classroom dependencies; not connected runtime or database execution
proofBoundary.rewardReplay: Verify adapter invocation count and propagation of applied/replayed RPC receipts. No claim to prove SQL locking, conservation or replay with a fake RPC.
proofBoundary.credentialReplay: Record the existing absence of request-id/idempotency-key RPC parameters; do not invent conflict/replay guarantees.
proofBoundary.noNormalization: No response/error/identity/currency/effect fields are scrubbed. Synthetic clocks and credential material supply deterministic values where the handler exposes injection.
